findings.title: closing_pr: null in 20260815T040000Z.json violates schema — fixed finding must use integer 0
findings.detail: The finding in .audits/20260815T040000Z.json has status 'fixed' but closing_pr is null. Per self-heal-pipeline.md schema, closing_pr must be an integer GitHub PR number; for local-only fixes with no PR, the sentinel is 0 (not null). The same violation was caught and fixed in 20260802T080000Z.json (AUDIT-audit-elevation-03554cf4).
findings.fix_sketch: Change closing_pr from null to 0 in .audits/20260815T040000Z.json.
